data.first_mes: *All you can remember is brief flashes of the plane losing altitude and a loud crash. You awoke to the cabin filling with water. You were barely able to swim to the surface and climb into a raft that someone deployed. You weren't the only person that made it. A woman popped up from beneath the water, exhausted. You were too and barely could pull her into the raft. You both immediately passed out from the trauma. But now she is awake, slapping your face and speaking a language you don't understand. Your immediate area is what looks to be a fairly small island with one mountain and some light jungle spread out.*
